cases.before_rationale:
Complete Clyde Amendment1 and its recorded rejection are bound to the retained RH page26target and the rule deeming the committee substitute adopted. It inserts text after final agency action in the direct-harm claim condition, specifying aesthetic, recreational or emotional interests unaccompanied by material physical or property harm. The unaccompanied qualification remains; this is not a statement that every such interest is excluded even with material harm. The selected page also shows other claim conditions and supplemental-document limits, but not the whole judicial-review section or following Tribal-resource qualifications. Whole direct-harm/claim/Tribal exceptions, standing/remedy baselines and Infrastructure membership remain pending; no antecedent ambiguity or court outcome is silently resolved. The205–220 recorded rejection with14Not Voting overrides the preliminary voice result and did not add this text to the bill.

Dated comparative framework ONLY: complete retained2024operative sections4336/4336a/4336b/4336c are linked, with later notes excluded. This is not a current conformed-law certificate or a calculation of this exact proposal's whole effects. Section4336keeps four threshold exceptions, separate EISversusEA/unknown-significance tests, categorical-exclusion qualifications and reliable-data discretion; new scientific/technical research is not required UNLESS essential to a reasoned choice among alternatives AND overall cost/time are not unreasonable. Section4336a preserves lead/cooperating roles, jurisdiction-by-law OR special-expertise qualification for cooperating agencies, and practicable single-document review. Sponsor preparation remains under agency supervision with independent agency evaluation/responsibility. EISpage limits are150or300for extraordinary complexity, EA75, excluding citations/appendices. The EIS2year/EA1year clocks run from the SOONER OF the applicable three printed triggers, with consultation-based necessary extensions. A missed deadline permits a court petition; a qualifying court order sets an agency-action schedule as soon as practicable, NOT EXCEEDING90days UNLESS longer is necessary to comply with applicable law. None of those clocks or remedies automatically approves a project. Section4336b allows related-action reliance on a programmatic document for which judicial review was available: within5years subject to substantial-new-circumstances/information about significant adverse effects; after5years only after reevaluating the analysis and underlying assumptions to ensure reliance remains valid. It is not unconditional five-year reuse, automatic expiration or perpetual unreviewed reliance. Section4336c adoption of another agency's categorical exclusion requires identification, consultation, public identification and documented adoption, not automatic cross-agency transfer. These dated program rules do not determine the failed child's direct-harm/causation/significance criteria or import rejected changes into the passed parent. All original exact-child/target, selected-body extent, parent floor/package, unreviewed Tribal/standing/other-law and domain limits remain. No new whole-parent-body reading, current-law/project outcome, actual jurisdiction ruling or accepted membership; all four cases remain pending with existing flags.

cases.before_rationale:
Complete Roy Amendment5, offered as Perry’s designee, replaces RH page5lines15–18 with effects within jurisdiction by law of the lead agency OR cooperating Federal agencies, together with reasonably close causal relationship and proximate-cause requirements tied to the immediate project/action. The OR agency alternative and both causal qualifications remain; it is not a requirement that every agency independently have jurisdiction. The selected target also shows clause2effect exclusions, which this replacement does not itself strike. Whole NEPA scope, jurisdiction/material legal baselines and Infrastructure membership remain pending. Its208–214 rejection with16Not Voting did not replace the clause despite the earlier voice result. No project-specific effect, environmental outcome or motive is inferred.

cases.before_rationale:
Of the27,742-character H.R.4776 EH, only the first3,000 and last1,200 characters were read alongside its complete own passage unit. The opening proposes purpose, review-level and research/scope changes; the ending includes appeal/deadline language and a separate exception for specified voluntary-remand/reopening/reconsideration/corrective actions during January20,2025 through enactment. Whole operative NEPA, deadlines, definitions, judicial review, correction exceptions, incorporated RH/floor/EH versions and material baselines remain pending. The bill’s proposed description of NEPA as procedural does not make this final-passage vote non-counting procedural context. Its221–196 passage with16Not Voting is separate from rejected children and does not enact a statute, approve a project or establish an environmental/economic outcome.
